Subject: Request: compliance architecture walkthrough for SOC 2 readiness

Hi Soojin,

We just entered the procurement phase for a pilot with Redwood and our security team asked for an architecture-level walkthrough focused on SOC 2 controls and evidence collection. Specifically they'd like to cover SSO/SAML, encryption-at-rest and key management, audit log capture/retention, and what artifacts Redwood can provide for Type II.

Can we schedule a 60–90 minute technical deep-dive next week (US Eastern preferred)? Typical attendees from our side would be myself (Security PM) and two engineers. Typical agenda: 1) high-level architecture, 2) where evidence lives and how to request it, 3) encryption/key management, 4) logging and retention, 5) open Q&A.

We are aiming to close onboarding sign-off by the end of the month, so a quick turnaround would help. My available windows (Eastern): Tue 11/17 9–12, Wed 11/18 14–17, Fri 11/20 10–13. If you can propose a slot and a short prep checklist, we’ll confirm.

Thanks,
Jordan Sullivan
Security Program Manager
FinServ AI

Quick notes for your reviewers before the meeting:
- Encryption: keys are stored in customer-specific KMS or Redwood-managed HSMs depending on deployment; rotation cadence is quarterly by default; for Private we support customer-provided KMS (bring-your-own-key). See encryption-keyflow.pdf for diagrams.
- Audit logs: default retention is 90 days in the hosted plan, with configurable exports to S3 or streaming via our Events API for longer retention.
- SOC 2 artifacts: the evidence bundle includes control mappings and sample reports; we’ll walk the controls during the call and agree on any follow-ups.

Apologies for the schedule shift — please confirm 11/19 if okay and we’ll send an updated invite.

Best,
